messages:
mia: Quick check — who owns final sign-off for the Optimize Toolkit quant recommendations? We need a short ownership callout + blockers so we can lock the delivery on Wednesday. Main open items: CR for quant profiles, batching infra integration, and the regression alerts from the smoke runs.

leo: I can take sign-off for the quant recs (will coordinate with model-ops). FYI PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/612 — awaiting ashley infra thumbs for the batching knobs.

ashley: infra side: batching config looks fine but we need a simple sane default in the autoscaler hook. Leaving a comment on the PR with suggested `max_batch_ms` tweak. @sam do you want to validate on staging?

sam: Yep, I'll validate on staging and run the new batching profile against the perf harness. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Adding a small CI job: `ci/batch-smoke.sh` that runs a 5m popload to catch regressions.

dory: Heads-up — regression alert from last night's run: int8 path produced a token-length mismatch on A100 when sequence len > 2048. Logged issue #457 and pushed a minimal repro in the ticket. Might be a kernel/path selection bug. cc @leo @mia

leo: Thanks @dory — I saw the repro. Quick triage: seems tied to the new KV cache padding change. I can try a local fix but need to rerun quant metrics after. If fix is non-trivial we should plan a canary on Dedicated first.

mia: Actionable list then: 1) leo — try the KV padding revert/fix and post results (owner for quant sign-off) 2) ashley — finalize autoscaler batching defaults and leave config in PR 612 3) sam — run staging validation + add CI smoke job 4) dory — keep debugging reg issue #457 and paste short repro steps in the ticket. I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow morning only if any of these slip.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: optkit/canary -> staging at 2024-06-13T08:30Z (:eyes:)

mia: Perfect — please drop quick one-line updates here when you have them. If anyone needs to reassign, call it out so I can update the delivery board. :thumbsup:
